description: A from-scratch rich text editor control for WinUI 3, rendered with Win2D (CanvasVirtualControl / CanvasTextLayout). A port of AvaloniaRichEditor: text/paragraph formatting, tables (nested, colspan/rowspan, resize), inline & block images, hyperlinks, undo/redo, CJK/Korean IME, clipboard (rich/HTML/RTF), page view, print/PDF, find, and drop-in host controls. Byte-compatible .flow document format. Native AOT ready.
releaseNotes: See CHANGELOG.md. ONE BREAKING RENAME, released in 1.x as a documented SemVer exception: RichEditor.TextForeground/TextForegroundProperty is now DefaultForeground/DefaultForegroundProperty (same meaning, matching the upstream AvaloniaRichEditor 1.3.0 and DefaultFontFamily/DefaultFontSize; no alias). Everything else ADDS API. ALSO CHECK: a bare RichEditor now always reflows (RichEditor.ViewMode = Continuous by default) -- set ViewMode = RichEditorViewMode.Page to draw pages; RichEditorView opens in page view; the toolbar's paper/orientation/margin fields appear only in page view. Public InsertText is one undo step per call. NotifyDocumentChanged() tells the editor the host edited Document in place. JSON is written lean (schema still 1.0, every 1.0+ reader reads it; a document of a newer major version is refused). New: page margins as a document setting (PageMargins in millimetres, PageSetup.Margin/DefaultMargin/PaperMillimetres/DipsPerMm, RichEditor.PageMargin, saved in JSON/.flow and read and written by RTF together with the paper size); table row/column commands a host can call (InsertTableRow/DeleteTableRow/InsertTableColumn/DeleteTableColumn and the caret-relative InsertRowAbove/InsertRowBelow/DeleteRow/InsertColumnLeft/InsertColumnRight/DeleteColumn -- one undo step each, false when nothing changed); the shortcut table (RichEditorShortcuts.All/Display, RichEditorShortcutId, RichEditorShortcut); Block.AutoTopMargin; a quote button and a five-step margin picker in the toolbar. BEHAVIOUR CHANGES: (1) the page margin is 15 mm on every side unless the document says otherwise -- it used to be a fixed 48 x 40 DIP, so page view, printing and PDF lay out slightly differently. (2) New tables, pictures and dividers sit one line below the text above them (Block.MarginTop defaults to NaN = AutoTopMargin; a host reading MarginTop must expect NaN). Saved files are unaffected: 1.2 always wrote the margin, and a written value, 0 included, is kept. (3) A block inserted at the very start or end of a paragraph goes before or after it instead of splitting it. (4) Tab in the last cell of ANY table adds a row (it used to jump to the next table). (5) Commands that change nothing no longer leave an undo step or mark the document modified. (6) Empty paragraphs are written to HTML with a br so other apps show the blank line, and a cell holding a picture writes its paragraphs as elements. SECURITY: pasted HTML never reads pictures from network shares (an SMB connection could present the user's NTLM credentials), and javascript:/vbscript:/data: links are dropped on every input path -- HTML, RTF HYPERLINK fields, JSON and .flow -- and never written to HTML. Fixed: copy and paste failing silently while a clipboard watcher (Win+V history, a clipboard manager) briefly held the clipboard (6% of pastes measured), table API edits leaving a removed object selected, RTF margins not coming back to their millimetre value, empty list items lost in an HTML round trip, a text drag that lost pointer capture being dropped by the next click. Memory: pictures far from the viewport release their decode (a 100-photo document read to the end: 501 MB -> 257 MB), the layout cache no longer grows with scrolling, an editor taken out of the visual tree releases its layouts and far pictures, the Win2D device is trimmed after releases, and the font list no longer opens every installed font (+31.6 MB -> +0.7 MB). Verification: 815 -> 953 tests, every fix falsified, JIT and Native AOT builds compared byte for byte on the same editing sequence.
title: WinUIRichEditor
